Verification Summary Report — NeuroPulse System

This report summarises the verification of the system, component by component: for each requirement allocated to a component, the protocols that verify it, their executions and results. The procedures are in DOC-0004 and their executions are reported in DOC-0005.

A Verification Summary Report is a type of its own that extends Document: its sections are its template's, so every report of this type lays out its scope the same way. The report holds only this prose and its scope, a query for the top of the component tree; each component gets a section of the requirements allocated to it, and each subcomponent a subsection of its own, so a component or requirement added later is in the next export of this report without editing it.
